notes: Lighting control console (ETC Eos family), not a traditional AV switcher/display — mapped to category "control" / type "Control processor" as closest fit. Sourced from ETC's own Tech-Specs page (etcconnect.com) cross-verified against two versions of ETC's official Ion Xe 20 datasheet PDF (Rev C 02/2018 and Rev D 2022-01, both ETC-authored, mirrored on musson.com and storm.rent CDNs) — content matches exactly. Desktop unit, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted); the rack-mount "Ion Xe RPU" is a separate product/model. Four DMX-512/RDM ports use 5-pin XLR (xlr5); primary function is DMX output, but RDM adds bidirectional device-discovery/data return over the same connector. Two Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 ports (individually configurable, sACN/Art-Net output). USB is spec'd only as "USB 3.1 ports (5 USB-A, 2 USB-C)" without Gen1/Gen2 distinction — grade usb-5g (5Gbps) is inferred/medium-confidence since plain "USB 3.1" most commonly denotes Gen1; could actually be usb-10g if Gen2. Two DisplayPort video outputs support 1920x1080–3840x2160 external monitors, but ETC does not state a DP version, so grade is omitted (resolution alone doesn't confirm DP 1.2/1.4/2.0). Console also has internal 802.11ac WiFi and Bluetooth 5.1 radios (future-software-enabled) and a Kensington lock slot — omitted as neither is a physical signal/power connector. Not confirmed: exact front-vs-rear physical placement of individual USB ports (spec states one USB-A is front-panel, remainder rear/keyboard-tray) — port list reflects total counts only, not per-port location.

ports.name: Contact Closure (D-Sub)
ports.note: Closest taxonomy match; physically a D-Sub connector for basic contact-closure triggers (not literal RS-232 serial data). Fuller MIDI/SMPTE/analog-serial I/O requires an external ETC Response/I/O Gateway and is not a native port on this console, so it is excluded here.

ports.name: Littlite
ports.note: 3-pin XLR-shaped accessory power port supplying 12V DC to the included gooseneck task light, not an audio connector; xlr3 chosen as closest shape match.
